rows.chagee:JR560:
CHAGEE (pronounced CHAH-jee) is a modern teahouse with more than 7,500 locations globally.

We are a global brand with proud roots in Yunnan, committed to bringing people together through tea. CHAGEE is awakening a modern tea movement, grounded in authentic heritage, fueled by cutting edge innovation, and crafted to nourish body and spirit.

The Modern Tea Movement starts with you. At CHAGEE, we're connecting the world through modern tea — making friends, pouring tea, and building careers along the way. Join a team rooted in tradition, fueled by purpose, and scaling a global movement across North America.

Position Overview

Elevate your career with CHAGEE as a Manager, Operations, Integration & training. You will play a crucial role in ensuring that all new hires and existing employees receive effective, consistent, and compliant training to meet operational standards and business needs. This role is focused on improving store operations by identifying skill gaps, developing tailored learning programs, and continuously enhancing the training experience. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to support employee development, enhance productivity, and maintain high standards of customer service across all CHAGEE locations.

What you'll do:

Onboarding & New Hire Training

•
Manage the new hire onboarding process, including scheduling, delivering, and tracking completion of training.

•
Ensure a smooth and engaging onboarding experience that sets employees up for success.

•
Provide orientation on CHAGEE’s brand values, culture, operational standards, and health and safety regulations.

•
Lead the operational integration of new products, equipment, technology, and business initiatives from concept through field execution.

•
Translate strategy into practical operating plans that are easy for teahouse teams to understand and execute.

•
Anticipate operational challenges early and develop solutions that simplify execution.

•
Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure initiatives are designed with the teahouse experience at the center.

Training Program Development

• Collaborate with operations partners to identify training gaps and develop targeted learning programs tailored to specific needs and roles in store operations.

•
Ensure all mandatory compliance training is delivered and documented according to regulations.

•
Develop processes, tools, and operating standards that enable consistent execution across a growing teahouse networks.

•
Create playbooks, SOPs, implementation guides, and operational resources that support sustainable growth.

•
Continuously evaluate and improve operational processes based on feedback from the field.

•
Support operational readiness for new teahouse openings and expansion initiatives.

Facilitation & Delivery

•
Facilitate training sessions for new and existing employees on various topics, including operational processes, quality standards, product knowledge, and company procedures.

•
Conduct training on limited-time offers, promotions, and new product launches to ensure team preparedness and consistency.

•
Support and develop the skills of in-store training support teams, providing feedback, coaching, and mentorship.

Training Evaluation & Continuous Improvement

•
Track training completion rates and assess learner performance through post-training evaluations.

•
Utilize learning management systems to gather data on training effectiveness and generate reports for stakeholders.

•
Actively seek feedback from trainees and managers to optimize training programs, streamline processes, and improve the overall learning experience.

•
Continuously update training materials to reflect changes in regulations, operational standards, and product offerings.

•
Partner closely with the Training team to design and evolve scalable learning programs that prepare teahouse teams for success.

•
Help build onboarding experiences, role-based training, certification programs, and operational learning tools.

•
Translate operational priorities into engaging and practical learning solutions.

•
Use field insights and operational performance to continuously improve training programs and resources.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

•
Partner with operations, HR, and store leadership to align training programs with business goals and operational needs.

•
Coordinate with the Consumer Insights to integrate customer feedback into training programs and service recovery initiatives.

•
Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability in a rapidly evolving environment.

•
Be prepared for duties and responsibilities to evolve, and show a willingness to step outside of your usual scope to support the company's growth. Expect opportunities for personal and professional growth as you navigate new challenges.

•
Build trusted partnerships across R&D, Finance, Marketing, Culinary, Supply Chain, Food Safety, HR, Construction and Business Development.

•
Bring an operator's perspective to business decisions.

•
Influence without direct authority by building alignment, fostering collaboration, and keeping teams focused on successful execution.

Experience you need to be successful

•
7+ years of progressive experience in restaurant, coffee, hospitality, or retail operations.

•
Experience supporting multi-unit operations in a corporate, field leadership, or operational excellence capacity.

•
Demonstrated success building training programs, operational systems, or scalable field enablement tools.

•
Proven experience leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through successful implementation.

•
Strong understanding of restaurant operations.

•
Excellent project management, communication, and relationship-building skills.

•
Comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

•
Passion for developing people, simplifying operations, and creating exceptional guest experiences.

What We Offer:

•
Hybrid work schedule for a balanced life

•
401K with company match to secure your future

•
Yearly bonus opportunity

•
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

•
On-site fitness center and wellness programs

•
Exclusive discounts at our tea locations, theme parks, and gyms

•
Generous paid time off starting at 15 days, plus 7 federal holidays

•
Opportunities for continuous education and scholarships

•
Income protection including Disability, Life, and AD&D insurance

•
Bereavement leave for those difficult times

Join our team and be part of a brand that's as refreshing as our tea! We're excited to see how your talents will help us grow and create memorable experiences for our customers.

,

The estimated total cash compensation for this position is $80,400 — $120,600, inclusive of base salary and estimated bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate and may vary depending on factors including (but not limited to): relevant knowledge and experience, skills, education, certifications, overall qualifications, and your specific work location.

Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to be at the forefront of CHAGEE's expansion into the US market. Join us in shaping the future of premium tea culture and creating unforgettable experiences that will captivate American tea enthusiasts. Apply now and be part of something truly extraordinary!

rows.chagee:JR576:
CHAGEE (pronounced CHAH-jee) is a modern teahouse with more than 7,500 locations globally.

We are a global brand with proud roots in Yunnan, committed to bringing people together through tea. CHAGEE is awakening a modern tea movement, grounded in authentic heritage, fueled by cutting edge innovation, and crafted to nourish body and spirit.

Overview:

Elevate your career with CHAGEE as Director, Head of Supply Chain - North America.

Through our stores across China, Asia Pacific, and the United States, we serve a staggering 100 million cups of tea monthly. CHAGEE is excited to expand its presence in the US market. This is your chance to be part of an exhilarating journey as we deliver the taste of authentic tea culture to America.

Chagee is seeking a strategic and execution-focused Head of Supply Chain, Director – North America, to lead end-to-end supply chain operations across North America, ensuring availability, efficiency, quality, and scalability as the business expands. This role will oversee demand planning, procurement, logistics, inventory management, and supplier partnerships, while aligning closely with global supply chain standards and supporting local operational needs. The ideal candidate has deep experience in food & beverage or retail supply chain management, strong analytical and leadership skills, and thrives in high-growth environments.

The Modern Tea Movement starts with you. At CHAGEE, we're connecting the world through modern tea — making friends, pouring tea, and building careers along the way. Join a team rooted in tradition, fueled by purpose, and scaling a global movement across North America.

What you'll do:

•
Lead and manage the full supply chain function across North America, covering demand planning, sourcing, procurement, logistics, and inventory operations — and build a healthy ecosystem and excellent relationships with all vendors.

•
Develop and implement regional supply chain strategies aligned with global direction and tailored to local business needs.

•
Ensure consistent and timely product availability across stores while maintaining optimal inventory levels.

•
Build and manage a regional supplier network, including contract negotiation, performance management, and risk mitigation.

•
Oversee inbound and outbound logistics, including importation, warehousing, and distribution operations.

•
Partner with Store Development, Operations, and R&D teams to support new store launches, product rollouts, and market expansion.

•
Support new product R&D with fast response and high quality & reliable delivery, leveraging vendor sourcing and exploration of new sources of supply.

•
Lead S&OP processes, integrating forecasting, financial planning, and demand signals into procurement and logistics planning.

•
Monitor supply chain KPIs (e.g., fill rate, cost-to-serve, lead times, shrinkage), with a particular focus on COGS improvement and out-of-stock control, and drive continuous improvement.

•
Ensure compliance with U.S., Canadian, and Mexican regulations on food safety, traceability, labeling, customs, and environmental requirements.

•
Build and develop a high-performing supply chain team to support long-term regional growth.

•
Maintain strong communication and stakeholder engagement across global and local vendors, and global and regional teams.

Experience/Qualifications you need to be successful:

•
10+ years of experience in supply chain management, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role; food & beverage, QSR, or retail industry experience strongly preferred.

•
Proven success managing multi-country supply chain operations, including supplier management, logistics, and inventory planning.

•
Strong understanding of North American import/export procedures, food regulations, and cross-border logistics.

•
Experience implementing or working with supply chain systems (ERP, WMS, forecasting tools).

•
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.

•
Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills across global and regional teams, including global and local vendor partners.

•
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or APICS/CSCP certification is a plus.

This is a high-impact role for a supply chain leader ready to drive scalability, efficiency, and excellence—ensuring Chagee’s products and customer experience are consistently delivered with precision and care throughout North America.

What We Offer:

•
Hybrid work schedule for a balanced life

•
401K with company match to secure your future

•
Yearly bonus opportunity

•
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

•
On-site fitness center and wellness programs

•
Exclusive discounts at our tea locations, theme parks, and gyms

•
Generous paid time off starting at 15 days, plus 7 federal holidays

•
Opportunities for continuous education and scholarships

•
Income protection including Disability, Life, and AD&D insurance

•
Bereavement leave for those difficult times

Join our team and be part of a brand that's as refreshing as our tea! We're excited to see how your talents will help us grow and create memorable experiences for our customers.

The estimated total cash compensation for this position is $123,800 - $185,700 inclusive of base salary and estimated bonus.

Final compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate and may vary depending on factors including (but not limited to): relevant knowledge and experience, skills, education, certifications, overall qualifications, and your specific work location.

CHAGEE (pronounced CHAH-jee) is a modern teahouse with more than 7,500 locations globally.

We are a global brand with proud roots in Yunnan, committed to bringing people together through tea. CHAGEE is awakening a modern tea movement, grounded in authentic heritage, fueled by cutting edge innovation, and crafted to nourish body and spirit.

Overview:

Elevate your career with CHAGEE as Network & Store Technology Engineer - North America.

Through our stores across China, Asia Pacific, and the United States, we serve a staggering 100 million cups of tea monthly. CHAGEE is excited to expand its presence in the US market. This is your chance to be part of an exhilarating journey as we deliver the taste of authentic tea culture to America.

Chagee is seeking a strategic and execution-focused Network & Store Technology Engineer – North America

The Modern Tea Movement starts with you. At CHAGEE, we're connecting the world through modern tea — making friends, pouring tea, and building careers along the way. Join a team rooted in tradition, fueled by purpose, and scaling a global movement across North America.

Responsibilities

• Manage and support day-to-day IT operations for North America retail stores and corporate offices, with a focus on reliable store technology and network availability. • Plan, configure, deploy, and support network infrastructure, including firewalls, managed switches, VLANs, DHCP, wireless access points, network segmentation, and primary/backup ISP connectivity. • Support new store openings from planning through launch, including installation, configuration, testing, and troubleshooting of POS systems, payment devices, printers, scanners, scales, cameras, network equipment, and other store technology. • Monitor and maintain network health, firewall status, Wi-Fi performance, ISP connectivity, VPN access, and overall system availability; identify and resolve issues before they significantly impact store operations. • Configure and maintain secure remote connectivity, including IPsec VPN solutions, firewall policies, network access controls, firmware updates, security patches, and other infrastructure improvements. • Troubleshoot store and office technology issues, including POS hardware and peripherals, desktops and laptops, receipt printers, payment devices, security cameras, and network equipment, including after-hours support when required. • Maintain IT asset, configuration, and network documentation; coordinate equipment purchasing, invoices, vendor support, hardware replacement, and lifecycle management. • Partner with store operations, internal teams, internet service providers, and technology vendors to coordinate installations, resolve incidents, and minimize disruption to business operations. • Support employee onboarding and offboarding by provisioning, updating, and removing network, VPN, device, and related IT access. • Develop support procedures and provide technical guidance and training to IT team members and store management to improve troubleshooting consistency and operational readiness.

Qualifications

• 8+ years of hands-on IT operations, network administration, infrastructure support, or retail technology experience. • Strong experience supporting multi-site retail, restaurant, or other store-based environments, including new store IT setup and ongoing operational support. • Hands-on experience configuring and supporting firewalls, managed switches, VLANs, DHCP, Wi-Fi, network segmentation, VPNs, and primary/backup internet connectivity. • Experience with firewall and network platforms such as Fortinet/FortiGate, Palo Alto, Cisco, Meraki, UniFi, TP-Link/Omada, or comparable technologies. • Strong troubleshooting experience with POS systems and store technology, including payment devices, printers, scanners, cameras, desktops/laptops, and network-connected peripherals. • Working knowledge of network security practices, access controls, firmware and security updates, device monitoring, and infrastructure documentation. • Experience with network monitoring and administration tools and protocols such as SNMP, SecureCRT, PuTTY, or similar tools. • Demonstrated ability to coordinate with store teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and service providers while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. • Ability to provide after-hours, weekend, or holiday support when required for critical store operations, incidents, or new store openings. • Strong communication, documentation, and hands-on problem-solving skills. English required; Mandarin and/or Cantonese language skills are helpful.

What We Offer:

• Hybrid work schedule for a balanced life

• 401K with company match to secure your future

• Yearly bonus opportunity

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

• On-site fitness center and wellness programs

• Exclusive discounts at our tea locations, theme parks, and gyms

• Generous paid time off starting at 15 days, plus 7 federal holidays

• Opportunities for continuous education and scholarships

• Bereavement leave for those difficult times
